design: Retrospective documentary audit of an explicitly enumerated programme-defined core; amended after earlier results were known. Not blinded selection, prospective registration or an exhaustive GLP-1 census.
primary_question: Within the enumerated adult treatment-initiation trial population, can the public material reconstruct each suicide-related component by original randomized arm and source-defined population/window?
unit_definition: One independently randomized trial population, with dose/active/control contrasts nested; SURMOUNT-OSA GPI1/GPI2 are separate populations under one registry. Never double-count pooled controls.
source_policy: Public registry, primary report, exact relevant supplement/correction, protocol/SAP and compatible regulatory source. Store citation, URL, version, hash and page/section. Distinguish auxiliary records and planned versus observed assessment.

REF_HISTORICAL_TREATED.definition: Reference retained in the historical input; reuse requires exact arms, source version, population and window. Population amendment is not an event re-review.

REF_ITT.definition: All randomized participants and assigned arms within the source-defined randomized follow-up.

REF_SAFETY_SOURCE.definition: Population explicitly defined for safety in the exact source. Do not equate dosed, exposed and randomized by assumption.

REF_ON_TREATMENT.definition: Source-defined treatment-emergent/on-treatment window with its explicit risk period.

classification_gate: A historical negative enters a new analytical cell only if exact source/version, arm set, population, reference/window and examined scope are supported. Otherwise preserve unknown; neither missing review nor unavailable source becomes a negative.
source_layers: A-B3 retained only with exact source version chronology; later intensive review is not interpreted as a causal effect of a source category.
human_review_policy: Only novel substantive scope decisions/conflicts without applicable prior adjudication; source curation and already ratified decisions do not generate repeat forms.
analysis_status: NOT STARTED. Next: exact source/arm/population/window extraction and compatibility checks; notify author before new documentary statistics and sensitivity analyses.
planned_results: Absolute trial counts and source/reference-specific classifications; primary modalities separate, direct versus derived separate; any union secondary; do not impute missing numerator/window or pool alternative references.
historical_dataset_policy: 182/159 analyses remain dated historical comparators and will not be overwritten.
source_date_policy: Use individually dated versions archived by this documentary cutoff. This is not proof that each was public on 19Oct2026. Later versions require a dated amendment and are not silently merged.
programme_enumeration_limit: Explicit bounded named-trial roster cross-checked against registry search and cited programme publications; do not claim an exhaustive census of all trials within the three programmes or of all GLP-1 trials.
source_update_phase: Current registry metadata only; no newly observed clinical outcome extracted.

population_rules.screening_after_dietary_runin: Screening eligibility and selection after response to a dietary intervention are recorded separately. Analyze the actually randomized population; do not treat all screened participants as randomized.
population_rules.regional_thresholds: Use exact locally specified protocol intervals. STEP12 has a BMI upper bound <30; SURMOUNT-CN has different local intervals and excludes diabetes.
population_rules.active_withdrawal: STEP4, SURMOUNT4 and SURMOUNT-MAINTAIN remain outside the primary initiation core; previous exclusions stay unchanged.
